name: IB Infotech Enterprises Limited
about: IB Infotech Enterprises Limited provides information technology enabled services in India. It offers software-related products; and trades in agricultural products, such as benzyl adnine, gibrellic acid, boric acid, citric acid, magnesium sulphate, zinc sulphate, zinc nitrate, and calcium sulphate. It also engages in lease transactions for electronics and office space and provides sublease services. The company was formerly known as Indian Beverages Limited and changed its name to IB Infotech Enterprises Limited in February 2000. IB Infotech Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Mumbai, India.
